text:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH - billing.counts drift detected for token-emitter-prod (eu-west-1). alerts: overage_flags=1.2k, late_window=+6m, delta=~18%
Maya: oncall here, picking this up. cc @Ben for billing, @Anita for ingest. first check: is this emitter duplication or downstream aggregation?
Ben: seeing matching spike in shadow-agg stream. counts upstream (raw-events) look normal. looks like duplicate writes to tally-service around 2026-03-17T02:12Z.
Lucas: Kafka consumer lag is low. consumer offsets steady. emitting service logs show repeated ack timeouts then retry paths kicking in. snippet: ```WARN tally-emitter - retry write id=0x4a3f backoff=200ms attempts=3```
Anita: grabbing head of emitter logs and redis keys. KV TTL expiry spiked around same time. Possible race in dedupe token key.
Maya: mitigation plan: 1) enable strict write-id de-dup on tally-service (hotfix toggle) 2) pause emitter retries for 15m 3) start a scrub job to dedupe recent window
Ben: enabling strict dedupe toggle now. will watch for decrease in duplicate writes. rolling to 2 instances first.
Grace: Support drafted a short customer note: "We observed intermittent billing count anomalies affecting usage reporting for a subset of customers in EU. We are actively mitigating and will provide reconciliation within 24 hours." Want QA on wording?
Lucas: pause retry endpoint: `curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/services/emitter/pause-retries` -> response 200. retries paused.
Maya: I triggered scrub for windows 02:00-02:20 UTC. job id: scrub-179123. will run dedupe and emit reconciliation deltas to shadow ledger.
Ben: toggle confirmed reduced duplicate writes. monitoring shows overage_flags trending down after 90s.
Anita: found root cause: race in emitter dedupe cache when Redis replica promoted during a rolling maintenance, TTL got truncated causing duplicated hash keys. filing bug.
Support-Bot: Created ticket #INC-7129 and customer-notify draft linked.
Maya: Customer impact: visible overage flags for ~180 customers, billing totals inflated for last 20m by ~15-25% depending on traffic pattern. Recommend pause auto-invoice until reconciliation.
Ben: I'll coordinate with finance to hold auto-charges for affected accounts and prepare backfill reconciliation.
Grace: updated support note to add expected timeline and reassurance about credits. sending to legal review.
Maya: postmortem TODOs: add replica promotion guard, increase dedupe TTL safety margin, add realtime anomaly throttle that gates overage flags. assigning tasks.
Lucas: rolling metrics: token_count_delta now within 2% baseline. continuing to observe for 30m before fully closing.
Ben: recommend followup run of full-day reconciliation job overnight. will schedule.
Maya: thanks all. leaving handoff to Ben for billing reconciliation and Grace for customer comms. marking incident as: mitigation_in_progress -> oncall_handoff.
Anita: creating PR for fix: https://git.internal/r/repo/commit/fe3b9 - will link to postmortem.
Maya: good job team :thumbsup:
thread_summary: Incident pager for billing.counts drift in eu-west-1. Oncall Maya coordinates SRE, billing, ingest. Hotfix toggles, pause retries, scrub job, and customer comms. Root cause: Redis replica promotion truncated dedupe TTL; duplicates written leading to overage flags; mitigation reduces drift; handoff to billing for reconciliation and support for customer notices.
